description: This file provides generic handlers for serializing and deserializing arrays to and from JSON, including specialized handlers for arrays of integers, booleans, doubles, strings, and sub-elements in a C project. It includes functions to convert JSON arrays to C arrays and vice versa, with support for optional and required arrays and sub-arrays.
